h1: Gusto vs. Rippling True 12-Month TCO Calculator (2026 Multi-State & PEPM Fee Audit)
summary: At 18 W-2 employees across 3 US states + 4 contractors, Gusto Simple/Plus costs $2,172–$3,888/yr all-in compared to Rippling's $5,196/yr (once Rippling's $85 Core platform minimum, $16/seat Payroll+HRIS bundle, and $20/mo per additional state tax filing fees are included)—saving SMBs $1,308 to $3,024 per year before state SUI taxes.

auditNotes: Unbundled Platform Core Trap: Rippling advertises 'Starts at $8/user/mo', which only covers the mandatory Unity Core directory. Adding US Payroll (+$8/user/mo), multi-state tax filing (+$20/state/mo), and time tracking pushes true PEPM to $16–$26/seat.

State Unemployment Insurance (SUI) Registration Fees: When hiring your first remote W-2 worker in a new state (e.g., NY, WA, NC), Rippling and ADP charge $150–$175 per state agency registration, whereas self-registration on state .gov portals (CA EDD, TX TWC, NYSDOL) costs $0.
Year-End W-2 & 1099-NEC Filing Parity: Both Gusto and Rippling include year-end federal/state W-2 and 1099-NEC e-filing at $0 per form, beating legacy bureaus like ADP RUN ($65 base + $7.50/form).

faq.q: What is the real 12-month cost difference between Gusto and Rippling for 18 employees?
faq.a: For 18 W-2 employees and 4 contractors across 3 states, Gusto Simple/Plus runs $2,172 to $3,888 per year all-in. Rippling Core + US Payroll + Multi-State Tax compliance runs approximately $5,196 per year ($433/mo), giving Gusto a $1,308 to $3,024 annual TCO advantage.

faq.q: Does Gusto or Rippling charge extra for year-end W-2 and 1099 forms in 2026?
faq.a: Neither Gusto nor Rippling charges per-form year-end W-2 or 1099-NEC e-filing fees in 2026. By contrast, legacy providers like ADP RUN and Paychex Flex charge $60–$65 base fees plus $6.75–$7.50 per W-2/1099 form every January.

faq.q: When is Rippling worth the higher per-employee-per-month (PEPM) price over Gusto?
faq.a: Rippling justifies its $1,300–$3,500+/yr premium when a company has 35+ employees and replaces separate IT device management (Jamf/Kandji at $8–$12/device) and SSO provisioning (Okta at $6–$10/seat) with Rippling IT.

faq.q: How do 2026 state SUI taxes impact my total payroll budget beyond software fees?
faq.a: Per IRS Publication 15 and state DOL schedules, every W-2 employee triggers 7.65% federal FICA, $42 federal FUTA (0.6% on the first $7,000), and $160–$1,290 in state SUI tax (e.g., $245/emp in CA on $7,000 wage base; $314/emp in NC on $31,400 wage base).
